name: Marlborough & Abel Tasman
about: New Zealand's driest, sunniest region; the Abel Tasman Coast Track, unlike the alpine Great Walks further south, stays walkable year-round.
overview: The South Island's top, an easy drive via Picton and Nelson — home to Marlborough Sauvignon Blanc and the golden-beach Abel Tasman Coast Track.
costOverview: Typical New Zealand pricing — a plate of local green-lipped mussels costs a reasonable amount, and a full-day wine tour through the region's Sauvignon Blanc vineyards is the one real splurge most visitors build in.

scenic.label: Golden-beach clarity, most of the year

specialSeasons.text: Harvest season in the vineyards — a lively time to visit, though also the busiest at the wineries.
